domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including improper mixed forms) and simplifying results

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (LCD/LCM of denominators) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that common denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Work explicitly finds an LCD/LCM of two denominators
Work rewrites one or both fractions into equivalent fractions with a shared denominator as preparation for subtraction (including converting only the fractional parts of mixed numbers)
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and no conversion is performed
Only reducing/simplifying a fraction (e.g., 4/10 to 2/5) is done without creating a common denominator for subtraction
Only rewriting mixed/whole numbers to improper fractions or to whole+fraction form without an LCD step (tag S03 instead)

skills.name: Subtract fractions
skills.definition: Subtract two fractions once they share a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator (including like-denominator cases).
inclusion_criteria: Work performs fraction subtraction in the form a/b − c/b = (a−c)/b (including results like 0/b or negative intermediate fractions)
Work subtracts fractional parts of mixed numbers after they are expressed with a common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Only whole-number subtraction is performed with no fractional subtraction shown
Only common-denominator conversion is performed without actually subtracting
Only borrowing/regrouping or only simplifying/reducing is performed without a fraction-subtraction operation

skills.name: Rewrite mixed/whole numbers
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed numbers, whole numbers, or improper mixed forms into an equivalent workable form (improper fraction or separated whole+fraction, including choosing a denominator) to enable subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Convert a mixed number to an improper fraction using (whole·denominator + numerator)/denominator
Interpret an improper mixed form as a sum (e.g., 1 4/3 = 1 + 4/3) or otherwise rewrite it into a standard form
Rewrite a whole number as a fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 4 = 12/3) or as a mixed number with a fractional part (e.g., 2 = 1 3/3)
Set up subtraction by separating whole and fractional parts (including using 0/b for a missing fractional part)
exclusion_criteria: Only finding an LCD and converting proper fractions to that denominator (tag S01 instead)
Only borrowing/regrouping from the whole part after an initial subtraction attempt (tag S04 instead)
Only simplifying/reducing a computed result (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: Regroup/borrow between whole and fractional parts when needed and express the final answer in simplest form (reduce fractions and simplify to mixed number/integer/0 as appropriate).
inclusion_criteria: Borrow 1 from the whole part and add denominator/denominator to the fractional part to make the fractional subtraction nonnegative
Reduce a fraction to lowest terms and/or simplify 0/b to 0
Convert an improper fraction result to a mixed number or recombine whole and fractional parts into the final form
exclusion_criteria: Straight fraction subtraction with no borrowing and no simplification beyond the subtraction step
Only rewriting inputs (tag S03) or only common-denominator conversion (tag S01) without regrouping/simplifying the result
